what_it_changes.architecture_documentation: Adds ARCHITECTURE-MUDA-MGK-BOUNDARY.md: the canonical boundary between the MUDA conceptual/formal kernel, the MUDA operational kernel, the wider Malla MUDA, the MGK governance kernel, external intelligence systems, actuators/executors, and human authority; every concept carries explicit status labels (CONCEPTUAL/FORMALIZED/OPERATIONALIZED/IMPLEMENTED/TESTED/FALSIFIABLE/INFERRED/NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED).
what_it_changes.version: Bumps package version to 0.3.0 and updates version identifiers in pyproject.toml, src/mgk/__init__.py, runtime/__init__.py, README-MGK.md.
what_it_changes.authority_boundary_hardening: runtime/decision.py human-gate state machine hardening: a human DENY becomes a durable terminal state; approve-after-deny, approve-after-execute, and any human-gate transition on a non-REQUIRE_HUMAN proposal is refused fail-closed with evidence event HUMAN_GATE_TRANSITION_DENIED. This removes the previously possible 'unauthorized human-gate transition' (approve-after-deny could execute).
what_it_changes.tests: Adds permanent discriminating regression tests for the durable human-gate state machine; adds adversarial red-team probes for unauthorized human-gate transitions.
what_it_changes.evidence: Adds evidence/v0.3.0/ including autopilot state, gap analysis, claim audit, mutation/redteam/install/release evidence, final candidate manifest.

what_it_does_not_change.kernel_authority_code: src/mgk/* (authority, verifier, executor, canonical, crypto, state, ledger, resource, saxp, cha, arrow, feedback, models, errors, clock, cli) is NOT changed in v0.3.0.
what_it_does_not_change.capability_model: The capability envelope schema, scope model, TTL bounds, nonce/replay protection, epoch handling, resource binding and digest identity are unchanged.
what_it_does_not_change.actuator_registry: The closed 5-action actuator registry (runtime/sandbox/__init__.py) is unchanged.
what_it_does_not_change.threat_model: The documented threat model is unchanged; no new authority surface is introduced.
what_it_does_not_change.protected_tcb: The protected root-of-trust tree (contracts/ROOT_MANIFEST.sha256, orchestrator/tcb/*, gates/protected/*, .github/workflows/*) is NOT modified in v0.3.0. NEXT_ROOT_MANIFEST_SHA256=UNCHANGED.
what_it_does_not_change.independent_exam: The frozen independent examination (independent_exam/) is unchanged.
what_it_does_not_change.contracts: Existing contracts (MGK-FUNCTIONAL-ACCEPTANCE, MGK-MUTATION-GATE-V2, MGK-SECURITY-MUTATION-ADEQUACY-V1, PHASES, INVARIANTS) are unchanged.

authority_invariants: INTELLIGENCE != AUTHORITY (I != A); proposal != authorization != execution
NO GOVERNED SIDE EFFECT WITHOUT VALID AUTHORITY
A proposal, model output, LLM response, or planner result is data; none is authority
Execution authority depends on the deterministic MGK control plane: scoped, short-lived, single-use, Ed25519-signed capability
REQUIRE_XEITO / human-review states must NOT execute directly
Human DENY is durable and terminal; no later approve may execute the same request
Fail-closed behavior, signature verification, epoch handling, nonce handling, resource binding, SAXP binding, and evidence persistence are preserved or strengthened, never weakened

threat_model.in_scope_attacker: An attacker who fully controls the planner/intelligence (compromised proposal source), can submit arbitrary proposals over the loopback API, can attempt replay/reuse/forgery/scope-confusion/TOCTOU/path-traversal/ledger-tamper/human-gate-transition attacks, and can attempt to obtain execution authority without a valid capability.
threat_model.outside_scope: Attacker with direct access to the operator's machine outside the local threat boundary; filesystem-wide rollback of state and the external root anchor; compromise of the kernel's private signing keys; physical access. These are outside the local threat boundary and never treated as authorized.
threat_model.authority_boundary: The MGK control plane is the only source of execution authority. The human gate is an authority-adjacent review step whose decisions are signed evidence and whose transitions are state-machine constrained.

backward_compatibility.api: The runtime HTTP/JSON API surface and proposal schema are unchanged.
backward_compatibility.capability: The capability envelope schema mgk-capability/v1 is unchanged.
backward_compatibility.cli: The mgk CLI surface is unchanged.
backward_compatibility.behavioral_note: One deliberate, documented behavior change: previously a human DENY could be overridden by a later APPROVE of the same request_id; in v0.3.0 the DENY is terminal. This is an authority-boundary hardening, not a feature regression. It is tested by new discriminating tests and adversarial probes.
backward_compatibility.evidence: All v0.2.0 evidence directories are historical and unchanged; v0.3.0 evidence is stored under evidence/v0.3.0/.

architecture_boundary.kernel_of_software: MGK governance kernel only (capability authority, verification, execution, evidence).
not_implemented_here: MUDA conceptual kernel (h x K = C0 equilibrium): CONCEPTUAL, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED
Rrep / Rlim / Rcog / CCI as named capacities: CONCEPTUAL, NOT_IMPLEMENTED
Malla MUDA as a whole: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; only the governance sub-layer is implemented
UCH, Afouteza, Latexo, Fractura de Campo: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
Full scientific validation of MUDA: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED

acceptance_gates.adversarial: Existing red-team corpus plus new human-gate transition probes must all PASS.

acceptance_gates.root_of_trust: Protected tree verification must PASS; protected paths must remain unmodified.
acceptance_gates.reproducibility: Clean install A/B + reproducibility must PASS.
acceptance_gates.claim_audit: Claim audit must PASS; no unsupported universal claims.
acceptance_gates.package: wheel + sdist build, installed-wheel smoke, artifact SHA-256 recorded.
